🚀 TEAM ASTROXX

We are Team ASTROXX, a passionate and innovative team driven by curiosity, creativity, and a shared interest in space exploration and technology. Our goal is to transform ideas into meaningful solutions by exploring NASA challenges, analysing real-world data, and using technology to solve problems.

Combining teamwork, AI, Data Science, and innovation, we aim to push boundaries, think beyond limits, and turn possibilities into reality.
